metadata.displayText:
## Context Editor (latest idea, strong candidate)
Inspect and manually edit an agent's context window before the next turn — pruning/compaction made visible and steerable instead of an automatic black-box heuristic.

Mechanism:
Agent turn N completes -> dump context (messages array) -> ctxed shows each entry (index, role, token count, preview) -> mark entries keep/drop/collapse-to-summary -> write…[truncated]
